title: Remote Work Policies Settle Into Hybrid Norm
summary: Most large employers land on three days in the office.

body.text: Analysts say the move could reshape how teams plan their next two years of work.
Further details are expected at a briefing scheduled for later this month.
We are only at the beginning of what this makes possible.
Critics argue the numbers are promising but still need to be confirmed at larger scale.
Long term, the impact will depend on adoption by the wider industry.

author.name: Priya Nair
author.bio: Covers startups, venture capital, and fintech.
